Alicia M.: Quick heads-up, ran rwd-v5.0-int4 through nightly shadowsuite; noticed fidelity drift on policy-docs long summaries (slice=policy-docs, lang=en).
Ben S.: How bad?
Alicia M.: Median semantic-sim delta ~0.035 vs fp16 baseline; hallucination uplift +2.8% on cited-fact checks; tail latency +9ms p95.
Chloe P.: Our canary rules: hard auto-fallback if semantic delta>0.05 OR hallucination uplift>3.0% sustained 10m; soft-fallback if any critical metric breaches softer thresholds for 2 consecutive 10m windows. This is borderline.
Diego R.: Proposal: block global promote. Run a paired 3k stratified rerun scoped to policy-docs with two variants: A) int4 baseline, B) int4 + per-channel recalib + kv-warmup. Evaluate embed cosine, hallucination rate, and token drift.
Alicia M.: I'll enqueue paired run and attach failing pairs. Also suspect quant-kernel fusion flag might affect rare legal tokens.
telemetry: queued paired run id=6990012345-paired, targets=3000, stratify=policy-docs:length>800. Interim agg every 10m.
Ben S.: Decision logic snippet: if (embed_cosine.median_delta < 0.03 AND hallucination.uplift < 1.5% AND latency.p95_delta < 12ms) -> allow soft-promote 5% for 30m, else if (embed_cosine.median_delta >= 0.05 OR hallucination.uplift >= 3.0%) -> auto-fallback to fp16 and pin. Hysteresis: require condition across 2 windows to avoid flaps.
Chloe P.: Also add slice-priority: policy-docs > contracts > general. Breach on policy-docs forces immediate region pin for eu-west-1 if dedicated nodes show divergence.
telemetry: interim agg (10m): embed_delta=0.028, hallucination_uplift=1.9%, latency_p95_delta=8ms
Alicia M.: borderline but improving with per-channel recalib variant. Continuing run.
telemetry: final agg: embed_delta=0.031, hallucination_uplift=2.4%, latency_p95_delta=10ms
Ben S.: According to decision logic we do NOT trigger auto-fallback, but block global promote and run extended 10k stratified follow-up focused on cite-heavy prompts. If follow-up passes criteria then soft-promote 2% ramp; else fallback.
Diego R.: Ops please have fallback automation ready to flip route and pin tag. Also enable sample-logging for any query with hallucination change >1% between variants.
ops-bot: acknowledged. Preparing fallback policy stub and watchbook entry.
Alicia M.: Uploading run artifacts and representative failing examples now. Will report results of the 10k follow-up in this thread.
Chloe P.: Thanks team. We'll re-evaluate after the 10k run.
